## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place, furnishing the house and adopting a persistent stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) after a failed attempt to chloroform him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to live with them, bringing along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)_

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) explains her easygoing view on chaperoning the girls at Patty's Place. She brings her two cats, the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), who undergo an adjustment period with the resident cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md). After initial turf wars and squabbles, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) accepts the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat's dominance and eventually becomes close friends with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) arrives with butter and chats with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about rising prices and simple living. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), which recounts humorously misspelled updates about his school, household misadventures, and curious questions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006), [v3 ch.Davy P21](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0021)_

> While preparing for April exams at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can keep the house for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on an evening walk in the park, where she reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) has proposed to her and she accepted. They discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) turns the conversation to Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place and chat with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about Phil's engagement and Aunt Jamesina's old suitors. Later, during a rainy evening of intense studying at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cheer themselves up by reading through dramatic stories written during their childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 ch.Opens P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her story sketches, which she happily celebrates with her housemates at Patty's Place. During a walking party with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns that his family intends to visit her. The Gardner family arrives a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to a frantic scramble and an awkward yet memorable call.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as examinations end and graduation arrives. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's lilies instead of Roy's flowers, but she breaks Gilbert's necklace after hearing a rumor about his upcoming engagement. She acts blithely through the graduation dance, refusing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) a dance, and later unwinds with her roommates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P39](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0039)_

> As the girls pack to leave Patty's Place after graduation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposes to her in romantic fashion, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his proposal. She returns home shaken and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eventually forgives and comforts her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_
